title: Summarize numbers from a file
statement: Read a nonempty sequence of signed integers from numbers.txt. Its first value is n, followed by n values. Create summary.txt containing the minimum, maximum, and sum in this order.
input_format: The text file numbers.txt contains n (1 <= n <= 1000), followed by n integers. Standard input is not used.
output_format: Create summary.txt and write the minimum, maximum, and sum separated by spaces. Standard output is not used.
